# America IPTV

> America IPTV is a subscription-based IPTV service centered on American live TV and on-demand content, delivered over the internet in up to 4K resolution where the plan, device, and source content support it. Plans include 40,000+ live channels (including major US networks, 24/7 news, and sports) and 180,000+ VOD titles. Subscriptions run 1, 3, 6, or 12 months, with a $1.00 24-hour trial available before committing. The service is compatible with Smart TVs, Android TV, Fire TV, Android and iOS devices, Windows, and macOS, using any player app that supports M3U playlists or Xtream Codes-style logins.
